resolvedQuestions: F5 references/structure, validation, workflows, config, plus SKILL.md vs commands/speckit

keyFindings.title: runtime/ENV-REFERENCE.md does not document SPECKIT_COMPILED_ROUTING
keyFindings.actual: runtime/ENV-REFERENCE.md has 0 occurrences of SPECKIT_COMPILED_ROUTING (grep -c -> 0); the flag is documented only in .env.example:133-134 and in the resolver/advisor sources
keyFindings.fix: drop runtime/ENV-REFERENCE.md from the governance doc source list, or add SPECKIT_COMPILED_ROUTING/_DEBUG to ENV-REFERENCE.md so it is truly canonical

keyFindings.title: Post-save review runs at Step 11.75 (post-index), not 10.5; indexing retired
keyFindings.actual: workflow.ts:1712-1723 runs Step 11 semantic indexing but logs 'Skipping retired legacy memory indexing' and sets memoryId=null (:449); the post-save review actually runs at Step 11.75 (workflow.ts:1741, invoked :1744-1753). indexMemoryFile() exists nowhere in live code.
keyFindings.fix: re-frame the review as running at Step 11.75 after the retired index step; drop 'before indexing begins' / 'proceeds to indexing' / indexMemoryFile() language

keyFindings.title: Phantom workflow-e2e.vitest.ts test file
keyFindings.actual: runtime/cli/tests/workflow-e2e.vitest.ts does not exist; real suite is workflow-*.vitest.ts
keyFindings.fix: point at the actual workflow test file(s) or drop the row

keyFindings.title: Phantom post-save-review companion entries
keyFindings.actual: Neither 05-pre-storage-quality-gate.md nor 01-verify-fix-verify-memory-quality-loop.md exists anywhere in the skill tree
keyFindings.fix: drop both phantom companion-entry references or rename to real companion docs

keyFindings.title: Phantom runtime/handlers/memory-save.ts save-path handler
keyFindings.actual: runtime/handlers/memory-save.ts does not exist; runtime/handlers/ holds only README.md, save/, spec-doc-discovery.ts. The validator runs via validator-registry.json (ts:spec-doc-structure) + validate.sh.
keyFindings.fix: replace the handler row with the real exposure (validator-registry / validate.sh integration), or drop the memory-save.ts row

keyFindings.title: compiled-route-status.cjs emits eight causeCode values, not the documented four
keyFindings.actual: compiled-route-status.cjs assigns at least eight causeCode values: compiled-serving (:267), flag-off (:235), legacy-authority (:231), missing-manifest (:214,222), engine-throw (:252), stale-manifest (:242), identity-mismatch (:262), compile-error (:183). Header comment (:19-28) already lists five.
keyFindings.fix: replace 'fourth code'/'documented four' with the full causeCode contract, or point operators at compiled-route-status.cjs:18-28 as authoritative

keyFindings.title: Playbook commands reference five non-existent test files
keyFindings.actual: tests/claude-code-capture.vitest.ts, tests/opencode-cli-capture.vitest.ts, tests/copilot-cli-capture.vitest.ts, tests/memory-render-fixture.vitest.ts, tests/workflow-e2e.vitest.ts are absent repo-wide; vitest fails when --run names a missing file
keyFindings.fix: replace the five phantom test-file names with the real suite files that exercise those lanes, so the npm test -- --run / npx vitest run commands execute

keyFindings.title: Expected signal 'Indexing succeeds' / 'indexes successfully' contradicts the retired index step
keyFindings.actual: workflow.ts:1712-1723 logs 'Skipping retired legacy memory indexing' and sets memoryId=null (:449); only the lexical trigger-index freshness check remains (workflow.ts:1725-1740)
keyFindings.fix: reword the signal/pass-condition to the trigger-index freshness check (or the canonical-spec-doc save landing) rather than 'indexing succeeds'

keyFindings.title: agent-io-contract.md cites a non-existent cross-root double-slash evidence path
keyFindings.actual: runtime//lib/deep-loop/post-dispatch-validate.ts has a double-slash typo and no runtime/lib/deep-loop/ exists under system-spec-kit; the real module is .opencode/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/lib/deep-loop/post-dispatch-validate.ts (and evidence-contract.ts)
keyFindings.fix: change the cited path to .opencode/skills/system-deep-loop/runtime/lib/deep-loop/post-dispatch-validate.ts and fix the runtime//lib double slash

keyFindings.title: spec-folder-write-recipe.md cites dist/spec-folder/backfill-graph-metadata.js; the file lives under dist/graph/
keyFindings.actual: runtime/cli/dist/spec-folder/ has no backfill-graph-metadata.js; it is at runtime/cli/dist/graph/backfill-graph-metadata.js (source runtime/cli/graph/backfill-graph-metadata.ts)

keyFindings.title: core-workflow-infrastructure.md runs two phantom vitest files and asserts a retired indexer
keyFindings.actual: tests/memory-indexer-weighting.vitest.ts and tests/workflow-e2e.vitest.ts are absent repo-wide (vitest fails when named); post-save-review/quality-scorer-calibration/generate-context-cli-authority exist. 'indexing/scoring regressions' describes a retired indexer (workflow.ts:1712-1723)
keyFindings.fix: drop the two phantom test files from the vitest command and reword the indexing signal to the live post-save-review / trigger-index freshness checks
